messages:
yves: Heads-up 1 found an archived partner upload that contains multiple KMS ciphertext blobs plus a tiny manifest that references our Vault path secret/data/staging/worker. No plaintext observed, but manifest lists svc ids and previous KMS ARNs. Treat as exposure and run containment.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20260607-01  priority=high  assigned=eng-security  link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260607-01 :rotating_light:

karla: s3 path and filenames? were they public?

yves: s3://partner-archive/exports/staging_2026-06-07.tar.gz 
notable files: staging/enc_creds.blob, staging/manifest.min.json
manifest contains: vault_path=secret/data/staging/worker, svc_accounts=[staging-worker], prev_kms=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555:key/old-id. Partner says it was public briefly; ACL removed. I copied object to s3://redwood-quarantine/4923456789/ and enabled object-lock.

ops-jen: Immediate checklist: 1) keep quarantine copy with object-lock + short TTL, 2) enable detailed Vault audit for secret/data/staging/worker and forward to SIEM for 90d, 3) create a dedicated rotor KMS key (alias/kms-rotor-stg-4923) with least-privileged grant for rewrap only, 4) draft temporary RBAC deny for non-ci-staging principals. I can do #2 and draft #4 now.

mona: Forensics: run a redacted vault snapshot and upload to audit bucket with TTL=48h. Example (redacted):
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/worker | jq 'del(.data.data.password, .data.data.token)' > /tmp/staging-worker-metadata.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-worker-metadata.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/4923456789-meta.json --sse aws:kms
```
Make sure bucket ACL is limited to sec-team and set lifecycle to 48h.

harry: I'll own KMS creation and rewrap. Plan: create alias/kms-rotor-stg-4923 in our account, restrict key policy to allow kms:ReEncrypt and kms:Decrypt for role:ops-rewrap from ops VPC only. Then run aws kms re-encrypt locally:
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://staging/enc_creds.blob --destination-key-id alias/kms-rotor-stg-4923 --source-encryption-context "VaultTransit=true" --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > creds.rewrapped
```
We will NOT return creds.rewrapped to partner. Instead we will issue new short-lived creds and require partner deletion proof (delete marker + version + signed attestation). ETA for key + grant ~30m.

karla: RBAC change (draft casbin):
```
# allow reads only for ci-staging role
p, role:ci-staging, secret/data/staging/worker, read, allow
p, *, secret/data/staging/worker, read, deny
```
I'll open PR to infra with immediate rollout flag. Keep rollback ready.

mona: Quick audit jq to find who touched that path in last 90d:
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/worker") | {time:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log
```
Post unknown accessor IDs here for revocation.

yves: Ran it and pasted first results  two accessors show partner-ci-consumer and one unknown id 9f3b2. Forwarded full audit extract to SIEM and linked to INC-20260607-01.

harry: Creating KMS key now and will provision a one-off grant for rewrap. Will not enable general Encrypt in policy. After rewrap we should rotate any long-lived Vault leases and revoke accessor ids tied to these svc accounts.

sec-bot: INC-20260607-01 update: responder=harry, kms_key_creation_started=true, quarantine_copy=true, audit_forwarding_enabled=true

ops-jen: Also: temporarily escalate Vault logging level for that path to include request body metadata (without storing secret values) and send alerts on any new reads. Keep the RBAC deny until creds validated and partner deletion proof received.

karla: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/10421 (casbin change)  rollout=immediate. Monitoring for pipeline breakage.

mona: After rewrap completes our post-containment steps: 1) issue new short-lived tokens (TTL<=15m) for staging-worker, 2) update running tasks/cronjobs to pick up new creds, 3) revoke old leases and revoke accessor IDs (remove associated tokens), 4) rotate any IAM keys referenced in the manifest.

yves: Partner security requested a sync. ops-jen, can we do a 20m call in 40m to hand off rewrap and request deletion evidence?

ops-jen: Yes I can join. Scheduling invite now. Will require partner to provide s3 delete marker + version id + signed attestation as deletion proof.

harry: KMS key and grant created. Starting re-encrypt now. Not returning any ciphertext to partner. After rewrap I'll post a short verification log and then start token rotation. ETA ~18m.

sec-bot: INC-20260607-01 update: rewrap_in_progress=true, responder=harry, expected_rotate_tasks=post-rewrap

karla: Checklist I'm tracking: quarantine, snapshot_uploaded, audit_forward, kms_key/grant created, rewrap in progress, casbin deny PR applied, rotate tokens pending, partner deletion proof pending, post-incident review TBD. Will update incident when rotation finished. :white_check_mark:
